recommendation.physical_justification: Finite pressure yield permits irreversible compaction; hardening arrests indefinite flow, while finite deviatoric yield retains crush/tear behavior.

pinch_vs_uniaxial.distinction: Jp responds in both prescribed pinch and guaranteed uniaxial compaction.

conclusions.adhesion_result: 1000 Pa adhesion raised z-mean but tore/stretched the block beyond the 0.06 m intact limit.
